messages:
jun: quick question — are we comfortable moving from opaque float scores to a stamped score envelope for /v2/rerank? want to lock format before console changes.
kevin: stamped how? like {score, confidence_band, model_id}? :thinking:
maria: +1 on including model_id. confidence bands would help telemetry and thresholding in console.
sam: concern: more bytes per candidate. some mobile customers send 1k candidates already. payload size matters.
jun: agreed about size. proposal: compact envelope: \n```
{ s:0.87, b:"high", m:"r2-small", f: "norm" }
```\nwhere keys are short (s,b,m,f). bands one of [low,mid,high].
kevin: can we guarantee backward-compat? most clients expect numeric score only.
maria: add header compatibility: if envelope present return envelope; else use legacy scalar. console will parse envelope first.
sam: routing/quotas question: when model_id differs, how do we bill fanout? e.g., request fans to 3 models with topk each.
jun: we already have per-model units but not per-candidate model stamp. propose: bill by candidate-model pairs actually invoked. if fallback path invoked, bill the used model.
kevin: telemetry: we should emit sample of raw score distributions per-band and per-tenant for drift alerts. doesn't need to be full histogram per request, can be sampler.
maria: console UX: show percentile bands on the rerank debug view + toggle to hide stamped payload. also show which model produced top-1.
sam: implementation nit: KV cache key must include model_id when stamping used for scoring, otherwise wrong cached ranks across variants.
jun: good catch. add model_id to cache key if envelope.m present.
infra-bot: lint: new proto change detected in api/rerank/v2.proto (diff: +model_id, +score_band, +short_keys)
deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: rerank-service in staging @ 2026-03-20T15:40Z
kevin: what about quota UI? want to expose candidate-cost estimate before enabling envelope so customers see impact.
maria: show estimated token/byte delta and projected unit cost in quota modal.
jun: next steps: kevin to draft proto change, sam to run size simulation on 5 customers, maria to sketch console UI, i'll file a quick RFC.
kevin: will do. aim to merge proto by EOD tomorrow.
maria: tagging @eng-product to sync on tenant billing messaging.
sam: if someone can add test harness for multi-model fanout billing i'll iterate on perf tests.
jun: thanks all. keeping this thread as the source for the RFC notes. :thumbsup:
